comment: The painted HUD icons (docs/design/ui-layout.md, 'Icons'). Made 2026-11-24 with ChatGPT image generation, one chat so the style holds, as 3x3 sheets on a transparent background, then cut with tools/slice_icon_sheet.py into 256 px PNGs here (names left to right, top to bottom). The game loads <name>.png at run time (HudIcons.cpp); a missing file falls back to text. To add icons: ask the same chat for another sheet 'in the exact same style, strict 3x3 grid, fully transparent background, no text, wide gaps', then slice it.
style: Hand-painted semi-realistic game icon art, bold readable silhouette, object centred filling about 80% of its cell, soft top-left lighting, rich but slightly muted colours with one accent colour per icon, thin dark outline for a dark UI. No text, frames or backgrounds.
